preservedResponsibilities: Original CPPU completion preserves the two-stage interface-list/call-table boundary, reverse attribute resolution before the completion guard, getter/setter index maps, provider/typedef replacement, identity-preserving registration and acquired256-entry cache eviction. It reuses the single actual allocator, registry, reference, string and atomic owners. Synthetic initialized caller records isolate this original completion mechanism; full interface/member factories, static types, UNO Type/Any/Reference/default RuntimeException and case service remain unfinished. Physical native ABI, cross-thread mutex scheduling, shutdown, malformed JS inputs, ordinary consumer reachability and full upstream QA are unverified. Normal and ASan/UBSan observations use full unchanged SAL/CPPU owners without substituted source methods; system libraries are uninstrumented.
omittedResponsibilities: Interface/member factories, static types, Type/Any/Reference/default RuntimeException and case service; native ABI/threading/shutdown/full consumer QA remain unfinished or unverified.
